summary: Phase 3 (Part 2 extended-response solutions with multimodal Gemini vision) tested end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 new pytest cases green in ~73s (real Gemini calls) covering list/detail/auth, subject filter, empty state, validation (empty submit, junk image, >5 files), typed-only submit, image submit (PNG handwriting, WEBP), multi-image, HEIC pipeline (pillow_heif -> normalized to JPEG/PNG served under /api/media/{id}), submissions endpoint + per-user scoping, and regression (extended_response excluded from /api/practice/start). Frontend: /app/part2 loads with nav 'Часть 2' (data-testid=nav-part2), subject select, task card (part2-task-<id>) for math_prof #13. Task detail renders scoring criteria (2 крит, до 2 б.), file upload via part2-upload-label -> part2-file-previews with remove buttons, typed_answer editable, part2-submit triggers real Gemini multimodal call, solution-analysis card with analysis-score (0/2 or up to 2/2 depending on solution quality) and analysis-criterion-<i> rows appears within ~60s. Past submissions section lists prior attempts. Back link returns to list. No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: analyze_solution errors are silently swallowed (bare except -> analysis=None). No logger.exception; a broken Gemini call is invisible in prod logs.
MAX_UPLOAD (12MB) is checked per-file only. A user could POST 5×12MB=60MB in one request; there is no aggregate size guard nor FastAPI-level max_request_size — risks worker memory on slow links.

get_image_base64 is called once per stored image sequentially (await round-trip to GridFS for each). For 5 images this doubles latency of an already 15-30s Gemini call. Read bytes from `norm` in-memory during store_image and pass base64 straight through — avoid the second GridFS fetch.

_extract_json takes substring between first '{' and last '}'. If Gemini returns commentary containing '{' or '}' outside a JSON block (e.g. LaTeX braces), the parser will produce corrupt JSON and fall through to the raw-text branch. Prefer a strict JSON-only prompt + JSONDecoder.raw_decode fallback.
No token/output cap and no timeout wrapper around _ask. If the model hangs, the FastAPI worker is held for the client's whole HTTP timeout.
Guidance keys are hardcoded subject ids — no fallback for future subjects; unknown subject_id gets the generic message but no metric/log is emitted.
Does not paginate: `.to_list(200)` — silently truncates once >200 extended_response tasks exist.
Loads full image via PIL synchronously in the request path (no run_in_executor). Large JPEGs will block the event loop, hurting concurrency.

issues: Subject <select> uses browser-native styling instead of the shadcn Select used elsewhere in the app — inconsistent look.
Submit button label 'Фили проверяет решение…' persists even for the fast typed-only path where the AI could return in <5s; no progress or streaming indicator (spinner icon).

action_items: Add logger.exception around solution_analysis.analyze_solution failures in routes_solution.submit_solution so real Gemini errors are observable.
Add aggregate upload size guard (sum of file sizes <= MAX_UPLOAD * MAX_IMAGES or a single MAX_TOTAL).
Skip the second GridFS round-trip: pass the normalized bytes we already have in-memory into the AI call.
Harden _extract_json (use json.JSONDecoder.raw_decode) so unbalanced braces in feedback don't hide the JSON.
Wrap _ask in asyncio.wait_for with a sensible timeout (e.g. 45s) and return analysis=None + a friendly message on timeout.
Move media_service.normalize_image PIL work off the event loop (asyncio.to_thread).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_solution.submit_solution — silent 'except Exception: analysis=None' hides ALL Gemini failures; must at minimum log with logger.exception.
media_service.store_image reads full image into memory then re-reads via GridFS (get_image_base64) purely to build base64 — dead round-trip.
solution_analysis._extract_json is a naive brace scan; add strict JSON parsing.
No rate-limiting on POST /part2/tasks/{id}/submit — each call triggers a paid Gemini vision request; a hostile client could burn tokens fast.
test_credentials: admin@lightstudy.ru / admin123 (used for UI test; onboarding-skipped). Fresh TEST_qa_* students auto-registered via conftest.
seed_data_creation: Reused pre-existing math_prof #13 extended_response task. Test submissions accumulate under TEST_qa_* users (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_part2_solutions.py as regression. It hits real Gemini (~70s runtime, tokens spent). Handwriting images are generated in-code via PIL+DejaVu; do NOT switch to blank/solid images (see /app/image_testing.md). HEIC test uses pillow_heif; if the writer path becomes unavailable it self-skips. UI test must log in as admin (or a student who has completed onboarding) — a freshly registered student is trapped in /onboarding and cannot reach /app/part2. Two prior real submissions on math_prof #13 exist (0/2 wrong-arithmetic and 2/2 correct) — reuse them for read-only checks.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. All Phase-3 acceptance criteria met.
